title: Pain d'Épices (French Honey Spice Loaf)
summary: A honey and rye loaf spiced with cinnamon, ginger, anise, clove and nutmeg, baked slowly until dark.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Warm
steps.text: Heat the honey, milk, butter and sugar gently, stirring, until the butter melts; cool 10 min. Heat the oven to 160 °C (140 °C fan) and line the tin.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk the flours, raising agents, spices, salt and zest in the bowl.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Whisk the eggs into the honey mix, pour onto the dry ingredients and whisk just until smooth.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into the tin and bake 50-60 min until dark brown and a skewer comes out clean; cover loosely with foil after 30 min if it browns fast.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool in the tin 10 min, then on a rack. Wrap and leave a day before slicing for the best flavour.

tips: Use a mild runny honey for the best flavour.
It slices better and tastes richer after a day.
storage: Wrap well and keep at room temperature for up to 1 week. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
